name: binarytrees
algorithm: binary-trees with one bump-allocated buffer of u32-index nodes in every language (B9); the sum of every tree check (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: not needed for the budgets; written if the checked column shows an overflow-check cost

no_counts: B24: the checksum is itself the operation count (every node built is checked once, and the total of the checks is printed)
